summary: Backend + frontend fully validated for CIKALA landing. 5/5 pytest backend tests pass (root, POST/GET /api/contact persistence, invalid email 422, missing fields 422, optional company). Frontend: all sections render (#inicio,#nosotros,#servicios,#productos,#contacto), ES/EN toggle switches all content, nav testids present, contact form submits (POST /api/contact -> 200), success toast appears, fields clear, HTML5 email validation blocks invalid email.

issues: nav-* anchor links use onClick smooth-scroll (no href attribute); works fine but not right-click 'open in new tab' friendly and not crawlable

critical_code_review_comments: server.py stores created_at as ISO string in DB but response_model expects datetime; currently converted on read. Consider storing native BSON datetime for query efficiency.
CORS allow_credentials=True with allow_origins='*' is invalid per spec; browsers will reject credentialed requests. Not currently used but should be tightened.
No rate limiting or spam protection on public POST /api/contact endpoint.
seed_data_creation: A few TEST_ prefixed contact_messages inserted during tests (not cleaned up; safe to purge).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend uses async Motor, contact endpoint at /api/contact. UI has data-testid on all interactive elements. Language toggle default is ES.
